podcast.body: A re-edition of his self-titled album. Jobriath is described as one of the great forgotten and hidden names of the Glam era, and this album was previously one of the most sought-after hidden records by Glam fans, almost impossible to find. The re-edition is a response to significant demand from Glam enthusiasts. "se redita del Jobriaz, uno de los discos escondidos más buscados por los fanáticos del glam poco conocido, entonces es que es imposible encontrar, aquí se redita finalmente."
